Shri T.A. Mirza, learned App has pointed out the order passed by the learned Single Judge of this
Court at Aurangabad Bench (Shri V.K. Jadhav, J.) in Criminal Writ Petition No. 2/2019 (Tushar
Subhash Getam & others Vs. The State of Maharashtra).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After considering the present matter and going through the above referred order, we are of the view that similar interim order in the present matter would sub-serve the interest of justice.

(i) The learned APP on instructions submits that, in terms of the provisions of Section 38(1)(c)
proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the petitioner herein.

He further states that, if such bond with the undertaking is executed voluntarily by the petitioner, then the 952APL254.19.odt department would not take recourse to the provisions of 2.1.3(4) of the Food Safety Standards Rules, 2011 and also to the circular dated 06.04.2017 and de-seal the grocery shop of the petitioner within seven days after execution of the bond and undertaking.

sentences.text: (ii) The learned advocate for the petitioner, on instructions, submits that the petitioner is ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and is also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future he would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc. in his grocery shop and he will not use his shop for selling those articles in future.
It is further directed that though investigation may go on, charge-sheet shall not be filed in the matter without seeking leave of this Court.

List this matter on 24th June, 2019 for further consideration along with Criminal (APL) 184/2019,
Criminal Application (APL) No. 280/2019, Criminal Application (APL) No. 210/2019 and Criminal Application (APL) No. 312/2019.
